description: Na₂Li₄Ni₂C₄SO₁₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Fddd space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share edges with two equivalent NiO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one SO₄ tetrahedra. There are four shorter (2.27 Å) and two longer (2.54 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Li is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.27 Å. Ni is bonded to six O atoms to form NiO₆ octahedra that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. There are a spread of Ni-O bond distances ranging from 2.06-2.16 Å. C is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three O atoms. There are two shorter (1.29 Å) and one longer (1.30 Å) C-O bond length. S is bonded to four equivalent O atoms to form SO₄ tetrahedra that share edges with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. All S-O bond lengths are 1.50 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Li, one Ni, and one C atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Ni, and one C atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to one Na, one Li, one Ni, and one C atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two equivalent Li, and one S atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONaLi₂S trigonal pyramids.
